site.name: CALIFORNIA
site.desc: CDPH monitoring one returned Hondius traveler via daily temperature checks and symptom assessment. A second California resident transited Tenerife to Nebraska NQU via CDC/HHS biocontainment charter. No California residents reported ill as of 14 May. Acting CDC Director Bhattacharya criticised on CNN for vague responses on hantavirus passenger monitoring procedures per The Daily Beast.
